name: Knox Fore Albed
original_name: ノックス・フォル・アルベド
source:
An inquisitor from the rival nation of Regenerate, ruling over a kingdom without a king.

He is the superior of Flatnis. Feared for his ruthless execution of anyone he deems guilty—including witches—he is relentless and arrogant, yet so competent that no one dares challenge him.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.otomate.jp/crazy_chain/chara/]official website[/url]]
